title: 2025 FOMC Press Releases

source.name: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

summary: This Federal Reserve webpage is a listing/index page that aggregates links to 12 FOMC statements and economic projections released throughout 2025 (January through December). The page does not contain the actual statement content—it only provides dates and titles of individual press releases. Last updated February 26, 2026.
key_points: This is a listing page containing links to 12 separate FOMC press releases from 2025, not the statements themselves.
Dates range from January 29, 2025 through December 10, 2025.
Each entry is either an 'FOMC statement' (monetary policy decision) or 'economic projections' (SEP/dot plot) release.
The page contains no substantive policy content—only titles, dates, and links.
The underlying individual press releases (not included here) would be the archiveable content.
why_it_matters: This page serves as a navigation index to 2025 Federal Reserve policy communications. However, it is not the archiveable artifact itself. Individual FOMC statements and projection releases contain the substantive policy content relevant for macro catalyst analysis.
